title: [Feature Request] Add CLI Tool for creating models, routes, middlewares etc
body:
### First Check

- [X] I added a very descriptive title here.
- [X] I used the GitHub search to find a similar question and didn't find it.
- [X] I searched the FastAPI documentation, with the integrated search.
- [X] I already searched in Google "How to X in FastAPI" and didn't find any information.
- [X] I already read and followed all the tutorial in the docs and didn't find an answer.
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Pydantic](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic).
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Swagger UI](https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui).
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [ReDoc](https://github.com/Redocly/redoc).

### Commit to Help

- [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆

### Example Code

```python
fastapi generate model User --fields=id:int,name:str  # Auto-create Pydantic model + SQLModel
fastapi generate route users --crud       # CRUD endpoints with dependencies
```


### Description

FastAPI is fantastic for rapid API development, but we can accelerate onboarding and reduce boilerplate by introducing a built-in **CLI** tool to **generate**:

- Models (Pydantic schemas with types)
- 
- CRUD Routes (with optional RESTful conventions)
- 
- Middlewares (CORS, Auth, Rate-limiting templates)
- 
- Project Scaffolding (Pre-configured main.py, configs/, etc.)

### Operating System

Linux

### Additional Context

This question is not related to an issue Ive faced whilses using FastAPI but a feature suggestion.

answer.body:
I, personally, don't see a point in generating models via command line. Looks more complicated than creating it in code :)

In general, consider using external tools like KianAnbarestani mentioned.
May also be interesting:
* https://github.com/fastapi/full-stack-fastapi-template
* https://github.com/benavlabs/fastcrud
* http://google.com :)
